blurb: Guests fish aboard the Sarah J., a boat licensed for up to 6 passengers. The captain provides all rods, bait, tackle, ice, and fillet service. Guests supply their own food, drinks, sunscreen, proper attire, and a cooler for cleaned fish.
extraNote: 30% nonrefundable deposit required to hold date; balance due at dock · Captain makes safety call on weather; unsafe conditions allow reschedule or deposit refund · Trips postponed due to weather or extenuating circumstances can be rescheduled within calendar year with 14+ days notice · Gratuity of 15-20% customary for mate · Spicer’s Marina, 93 Marsh Rd.
